messages:
Lena (Marketing): draft uploaded -> https://docs.google/draft. Need quick passes on hero line, benchmark blurb, CTAs, and inbound lead routing. aiming to lock by 4pm PT.

Owen (Product): glanced through. please hedge absolute percentages in the benchmark section and add a short customer quote placeholder.

Kai (Design): hero comps done. will export 2 sizes (desktop/mobile). need final hero copy for alt text.

Priya (Growth): adding UTMs and tracking. header CTA -> webinar RSVP. example UTM: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=april_launch`. also proposing CTA copy: 'Save your seat'.

Marcus (Sales Ops): inbound routing plan: Enterprise -> AE queue, Midmarket -> SDR. what are the exact HubSpot tag strings? i'll wire them once confirmed.

Owen (Product): quick tech quote: "We optimized batching and cache behavior to reduce tail latency for long-context workloads." short enough for hero.

LegalBot: auto-scan flagged 'unlimited scale' and 'industry-best' as unsupported claims. please reword or provide citation.

Lena (Marketing): swapped to 'high-throughput modes' and removed 'industry-best'. noted to link the infra benchmark appendix.

Priya (Growth): added RSVP button copy 'Save your seat' and secondary CTA -> demo request. tracking event `blog_cta_click` added with property cta_type.

Marcus (Sales Ops): suggested tag strings: `lead_tier=enterprise|midmarket|demo`, `source=blog`, `intent=webinar|demo`. i'll push routing to staging after final confirm.

Kai (Design): assets uploaded: hero_A.jpg, hero_B.jpg. alt suggestions left in the doc.

Lena (Marketing): locking copy at 16:00 PT. pushing to staging for preview. any last nits?

PublishBot: Publish window reserved for 2026-04-20 15:00 UTC.

Priya (Growth): small SEO tweak: move webinar blurb above the fold. i'll A/B test hero copy (speed vs cost) for first 24h.

Marcus (Sales Ops): routing rules deployed to staging. i'll monitor first-50 leads and report anomalies.

Lena (Marketing): thanks everyone  final checklist: legal issues addressed, hero quote in, assets uploaded, UTMs and routing mapped. will confirm schedule after staging preview.
